merged.finding: The inspector definition (EXPERIENCE.md:250-255) omits two contents the adapter contract requires in the inspector: the count of ignored unknown keys and the statement that caps are per observer process.
merged.evidence: Spec :38 "counted in the inspector (`n unrecognised keys`)"; spec :62 "caps are per observer process, and help and the inspector say so". UX :250-255 lists neither.
merged.reason: Missing required content: two spec-mandated inspector lines are absent (grep finds no 'unrecognised' or 'per observer process' in the UX folder).
merged.fix: Add two bullets after EXPERIENCE.md:255: "The inspector shows `n unrecognised keys` for unknown source keys that were ignored (adapter-contract.md:38)." and "The inspector states that caps are per observer process, so several observers multiply Orca load (adapter-contract.md:62)."

merged.finding: The spec requires help text carrying two statements, but the UX defines no help surface and says there is no help key, so no screen carries the required help sentences.
merged.evidence: UX :324 "There is no help key". Spec :52 "Help text: \"a completed Task can still own a live terminal\""; adapter-contract.md:62 "help and the inspector say so".
merged.reason: Missing required deliverable: the spec names help text content that the UX gives no place to appear.
merged.fix: At EXPERIENCE.md:324, add: "PROPOSED: help text is the `superclaude observe --help` output; it carries \"a completed Task can still own a live terminal\" (rendering-rules.md:52) and the per-observer-process caps sentence (adapter-contract.md:62)."

merged.finding: Attention Ledger's 80-115 column layout row drops the two invariant lines that the spec says stay at that width.
merged.evidence: Spec :42 "The invariant lines stay: \"Questions stay until explicit resolution.\" and \"No reply observed is not delivery failure.\"" UX :177 lists neither.
merged.reason: Contradiction with the spec: required lines are absent from the narrow B layout (grep finds no 'Questions stay until' in the UX folder).
merged.fix: In the B 80-115 row at EXPERIENCE.md:177, append: "plus the invariant lines \"Questions stay until explicit resolution.\" and \"No reply observed is not delivery failure.\", which stay at this width (rendering-rules.md:42)".

merged.finding: Historical rows are hidden by default with no exception, but the spec says historical evidence explicitly linked to a shown item is never hidden.
merged.evidence: UX :240 "Historical rows ... are hidden by default". Spec :22 "historical evidence explicitly linked to a shown item is never hidden".
merged.reason: Wrong behaviour against the spec: a builder following the UX would hide evidence the spec forbids hiding.
merged.fix: In the historical-rows bullet at EXPERIENCE.md:240, add: "Historical evidence explicitly linked to a shown item is never hidden (rendering-rules.md:22)."

merged.finding: The visual-reference table says the Signal Bridge panels including SIGNALS are shown in every Signal Bridge export, but the spec (and EXPERIENCE.md:54) say the 116- and 80-column builds drop SIGNALS; only the 160-column exports contain SIGNALS.
merged.evidence: UX :52 "shown in every Signal Bridge export | ... SIGNALS counts and bars". Spec :85 "its 116- and 80-column builds drop SIGNALS".
merged.reason: False claim and internal contradiction; grep of the design exports finds SIGNALS only in the exports/160 files.
merged.fix: Replace "shown in every Signal Bridge export" at EXPERIENCE.md:52 with "shown in the 160-column Signal Bridge export; the 116- and 80-column builds drop SIGNALS (rendering-rules.md:85)".

merged.finding: The filter count is placed on the status line, but the spec puts it beside the unfiltered source counts, and EXPERIENCE.md:294 itself says 'beside the unfiltered source counts'.
merged.evidence: UX :84 "Status line ... `filter <expr>: k of n collected`". Spec :56 "shows `filter <expr>: k of n collected` beside the unfiltered `source counts: ...`".
merged.reason: Contradiction with the spec and inside the UX (:84 vs :294); the status line also folds into the footer under height pressure.
merged.fix: Remove `filter <expr>: k of n collected` from the status-line list at EXPERIENCE.md:84 and add it to the COUNTS strip description at EXPERIENCE.md:82, placed directly after `source counts: ...` (rendering-rules.md:56).

merged.finding: Header line 1 is given as `as of <HH:MM:SS>` without saying it is the time of the last good poll, so a renderer can show render time and stale data reads as current.
merged.evidence: UX :80 "as of <HH:MM:SS>". Spec :17 "as of <local time of last good poll>".
merged.reason: The UX drops the spec's defining meaning of a freshness token, which permits wrong behaviour (stale shown as current).
merged.fix: At EXPERIENCE.md:80, replace `as of <HH:MM:SS>` with `as of <local time of last good poll>` (rendering-rules.md:17), keeping HH:MM:SS only as the display format.

merged.finding: The inspector is a full-screen replacement of the view that keeps its last values, so it hides the COUNTS strip (never dropped) and the freshness strip; when the source goes STALE or FAILED the inspector's old values read as current. DESIGN.md:173 and :210 say the same.
merged.evidence: UX :251 "A full-screen replacement of the view, not a pane." :465 "The inspector keeps its last values". Spec :19 "It is a minimum row and is never dropped."
merged.reason: Contradicts the spec's never-dropped COUNTS row and minimum content (rendering-rules.md:13, :19) and hides staleness from the user.
merged.fix: At EXPERIENCE.md:251 write "Replaces the ledger area only; header line 1, the freshness strip and the COUNTS strip stay above the inspector fields (rendering-rules.md:13, :19)." and change DESIGN.md:173 and :210 to match.

merged.finding: Under --ascii, DESIGN.md replaces every non-ASCII source character with `?`, including in the inspector and export, so full IDs become lossy and distinct IDs can look identical. This contradicts EXPERIENCE.md:375 and the spec, where --ascii replaces box drawing only.
merged.evidence: DESIGN :195 "under `--ascii`, any other non-ASCII character in source text is shown as `?`." UX :375 "The inspector and the export always show every ID in full". Spec :24 "replaces box drawing with `+-|`".
merged.reason: Contradiction between the two UX files and with rendering-rules.md:24-25, and a data-integrity risk (a copied ID can target the wrong worker).
merged.fix: At DESIGN.md:195, limit `?` replacement to ledger list cells and add: "In the inspector and the export, non-ASCII characters are written as `\uXXXX` escapes so every ID stays full and distinct (EXPERIENCE.md:375; rendering-rules.md:24-25)."

merged.finding: The sanitizer keeps newlines in the inspector, and the inspector lists fields one per line as label then value, so a worker-supplied value containing a newline followed by `dispatchId: x` renders as a spoofed field line.
merged.evidence: UX :368 "bare C0 control characters, except newline in the inspector"; :252 "Fields are listed one per line, label then value."
merged.reason: Security risk at the untrusted-text trust boundary: worker text can forge an observer field, and a supervisor may copy a fake ID.
merged.fix: At EXPERIENCE.md:252, add: "Continuation lines of a multi-line value are prefixed with a fixed indent marker (for example `  | `), in the inspector and the export, so no value line can start with a field label (adapter-contract.md:51)."

merged.finding: The fixed sentence attributes the 116-column collapse claim to the prototype, which reads as self-contradictory; the spec attributes it to the brief.
merged.evidence: UX "the prototype's 116-column collapse claim does not match the built prototype". Spec :85 "the prototype does not match the brief's collapse claim (X-001)".
merged.reason: Attribution wording on an otherwise true claim.

merged.finding: The release table says DIRECTION-SELECTED is 'not yet passed'; the owner decision leaves that judgement to the owner, so 'owner to confirm' is the more accurate wording.
merged.evidence: UX "DIRECTION-SELECTED (not yet passed; OQ-1)". Owner :9 "Whether this fully satisfies the DIRECTION-SELECTED gate is for the owner to say."
merged.reason: Wording: the gate has not been declared passed, so the text is not false, and it keeps OQ-1 open.

merged.finding: The under-80 row gives a 'short form at the reduced width' ledger and cites the spec, which defines only the notice and strip denominators under 80; the ledger form should be labelled PROPOSED.
merged.evidence: UX :108 "< 80 | short form at the reduced width". Spec :12 "Under 80 every view shows `terminal too narrow (min 80)` above the COUNTS strip".
merged.reason: Missing PROPOSED label on a design choice; the cited notice itself is correct.

merged.finding: The PROPOSED loading state defines `collected 0 / reported unknown` but does not say what the `source counts:` tokens read before the first poll; it should state they read unknown.
merged.evidence: UX :287 "COUNTS `collected 0 / reported unknown`" and "No value is ever shown as 0 except the count of rows actually collected".
merged.reason: Under-specified PROPOSED state; :287 already forbids any zero other than the collected count, so no wrong zero is specified.

merged.finding: The full PARTIAL sentence is placed on the one-line status line, a placement the spec does not make; it is not labelled PROPOSED, and the UX does not say how the long sentence wraps at 80 or 116 columns or where it goes when the status line folds.
merged.evidence: UX :289 "plus the full partial sentence on the status line". Spec :55 gives the sentence with no placement.
merged.reason: Unlabelled design choice and an undefined wrap rule; `PARTIAL` itself stays in the never-truncated COUNTS strip, so no required signal is lost.

merged.finding: `m` and `e` acting 'same as ledger' inside the inspector is not in the spec key list and is not labelled PROPOSED.
merged.evidence: UX :318-319 "`m` ... | same as ledger", "`e` ... | same as ledger". Spec :20 lists keys with no inspector mode.
merged.reason: Missing PROPOSED label; the behaviour does not contradict the spec.

merged.finding: 'The notice shows no number' is literally contradicted by the notice string, which contains '0 rows interpreted'; the intent is 'no question count'.
merged.evidence: UX :384 "The notice shows no number". Notice: "source UNVERIFIED, 0 rows interpreted, not \"no questions\"".
merged.reason: Wording; it mirrors the spec's own phrasing at rendering-rules.md:59 and the intended rule is clear.

merged.finding: The UX says `export(view)` writes the JSON snapshot, matching PRD FR-16 (prd.md:235), while stack.md:24 says `export(view)` writes the `e`/`--once` record form and the snapshot is a further serialization.
merged.evidence: UX :68 "`export(view)` writes the versioned JSON snapshot". stack.md:24 "`export(view)` writes the `e`/`--once` record form ... The JSON snapshot is a further serialization".
merged.reason: Naming difference only; the UX matches the PRD and owner decision 2, and the behaviour (a JSON snapshot each cycle) is the same.

merged.finding: Screen 7 cites an open-question ID `OQ-B/C` that is defined nowhere in the spec, PRD or addendum.
merged.evidence: UX :71 "(OQ-B/C, OI-4, OI-9)". grep finds no OQ-B in the spec folder, prd.md or addendum.md.
merged.reason: Citation defect; OI-4 and OI-9 next to it are valid.

merged.finding: The shrink rule says the too-small diagnostic keeps every row that never drops, without repeating that four of those five rows are PROPOSED, and does not say what happens when the height cannot hold even those rows.
merged.evidence: UX :163 "It keeps every row that never drops: the header, freshness, COUNTS, the gap notice and the footer." :135 "The other rows in this list are PROPOSED".
merged.reason: Label omission and an unspecified extreme edge; the spec (rendering-rules.md:13) also leaves it open.

merged.finding: Contrast ratios are marked UNVERIFIED although the reviewer recomputed them from the listed hex values and they match.
merged.evidence: DESIGN :128 "It was not re-measured here, so it is UNVERIFIED."
merged.reason: Conservative labelling, not a false claim; owner decision 5 permits UNVERIFIED for unchecked values.

merged.finding: The failed-poll state says last good rows are kept, but does not define the ledger body when the very first poll fails and there are no last good rows.
merged.evidence: UX :291 "`FAILED (...)` cell; last good rows kept with `as of`".
merged.reason: Undefined edge state; the freshness strip still shows FAILED and the PROPOSED loading line covers no data, so no false reading is specified.

merged.finding: The ledger body is not defined for the case where every collected row is hidden as historical or by the filter.
merged.evidence: UX :240 "hidden by default, with `k historical hidden (h)` shown".
merged.reason: Undefined edge state; `k historical hidden (h)` and `shown x/y` stay visible, so hidden rows do not read as absent.

merged.finding: The cursor text for a selected worker that is still in the source but hidden by the filter or the historical toggle is not defined; the only text given says it left the source window.
merged.evidence: UX "the cursor row reads `selected <id> no longer in source window` until the user moves."
merged.reason: Undefined edge case; the UX copies the spec rule (rendering-rules.md:23), which covers only disappearance.

merged.finding: Enter, j/k and e on the 'no longer in source window' cursor row, and the row reappearing, are not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "The cursor never jumps to another worker."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap with no contradiction.

merged.finding: `changed since HH:MM (0)` after a mark can read as 'no change' when polls failed or went stale and nothing was re-observed.
merged.evidence: UX "counted in `changed since HH:MM (k)` ... Rows on unread pages read `not reobserved`."
merged.reason: The count is of observed changes and the strip shows STALE or FAILED beside it; a clearer label is an improvement, not a fix of wrong behaviour.

merged.finding: Pressing `m` before the first successful poll (no baseline) is not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "The first observation in a process is the baseline. ... `m` records a mark in memory only."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: Handling of a worker record with an absent or empty `dispatchId` (selection anchor and dedupe key) is not stated in the UX.
merged.evidence: UX "Selection is anchored to identity (source namespace + `dispatchId`) ... Duplicates are dropped with `k duplicate rows ignored`."
merged.reason: Required-field and shape handling belongs to the adapter contract (adapter-contract.md:36-44); the UX gap is a cross-reference, not wrong behaviour.

merged.finding: Which copy of a duplicated identity is kept is not stated.
merged.evidence: UX "Duplicates are dropped with `k duplicate rows ignored`."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: Behaviour at widths far below 80 (for example 30), where never-cut tokens cannot fit, is not defined.
merged.evidence: UX :108 "< 80 | short form at the reduced width | `terminal too narrow (min 80)` above the COUNTS strip".
merged.reason: Unsupported-width edge; the spec defines only the notice under 80 (rendering-rules.md:12), and the UX copies it.

merged.finding: The UX does not say the 74-cell gap notice wraps rather than being cut, so a cut after '0 rows' could read as zero questions.
merged.evidence: UX :83 "`Human questions: source UNVERIFIED, 0 rows interpreted, not \"no questions\"`".
merged.reason: At the 80-column minimum the 74-cell notice fits on one line, and under 80 the too-narrow notice governs, so the cut case is not reachable in a supported width.

merged.finding: At 80 columns the freshness strip with STALE, a last FAILED reason, `cycle overran (Ns)` and the messages cell can exceed one line, and no wrap rule protects the state words.
merged.evidence: UX "PROPOSED: `STALE <age>, last poll FAILED (<reason>)`" and "the strip shows `cycle overran (Ns)`".
merged.reason: Undefined wrap rule on a PROPOSED composition; no spec rule is contradicted.

merged.finding: Interactive runs with stdin or stdout not a TTY, or stdin EOF mid-session, are not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "POSIX terminals run interactively."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap for implementation detail.

merged.finding: Terminal restore on Ctrl-Z suspend, resume and SIGHUP is not listed.
merged.evidence: UX "The terminal is restored (echo, cursor, alternate screen) on `q`, Ctrl-C, SIGTERM and an unhandled exception."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: Filter input handling of arrow keys, empty Enter, invalid and very long expressions is not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "`j`/`k` are typed as text; `Enter` ... apply the filter and return to the ledger".
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: Resizing below the minimum while the inspector or filter input is open, then back, is not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "A refresh never moves focus or selection. It never closes the inspector or the filter input".
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: DESIGN.md states the NO_COLOR trigger as any non-empty value while EXPERIENCE.md names only `NO_COLOR=1` and `NO_COLOR=yes`.
merged.evidence: DESIGN :140 "NO_COLOR set to a non-empty value"; UX :393 "`NO_COLOR=1` and `NO_COLOR=yes`".
merged.reason: EXPERIENCE.md quotes the two T26 test values (acceptance-tests.md:19), which are instances of DESIGN.md's general rule; wording only.

merged.finding: A non-UTF-8 terminal started without `--ascii` is not handled (no auto-detection).
merged.evidence: UX "Non-UTF-8 terminals use `--ascii`."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap; the UX copies the spec rule (rendering-rules.md:24).

merged.finding: A complete value that naturally ends with `>` is indistinguishable from a cut value.
merged.evidence: UX "List cells cut by display-cell width and end with a visible `>`".
merged.reason: Edge-case ambiguity; the inspector shows full values.

merged.finding: The sanitizer list does not name DEL (0x7F), U+2028/U+2029 or East Asian ambiguous-width characters.
merged.evidence: UX "C1 control characters; bare C0 control characters ...; Unicode format characters (category Cf)."
merged.reason: Hardening gap; the UX matches the adapter contract's sanitizer list.

merged.finding: Very long inspector values (megabytes of stage detail or stderr) have no paging or display cap.
merged.evidence: UX "Values are wrapped by cells and never truncated." / "A failed poll shows its sanitized stderr here."
merged.reason: Edge-case gap; the never-truncated rule comes from the spec (rendering-rules.md:25).

merged.finding: The freshness colour list gives no colour for NOT AVAILABLE or `cycle overran (Ns)`.
merged.evidence: DESIGN :202 "OK ink, STALE warn, FAILED bad, NOT POLLED muted, UNVERIFIED warn."
merged.reason: Colour is never the only signal (the text carries the state); styling gap only.

merged.finding: The live empty-fleet line lacks the 'not proof none exist' qualifier that the fixture empty line carries.
merged.evidence: UX :288 "`worker-list returned 0 workers in scope=<scope>`; fixture: `no observed items in this source window; not proof none exist`".
merged.reason: The live line states what the source returned with scope, not a claim that none exist; a wording improvement.

merged.finding: The `--once` layout form with no terminal width and its exit status after a failed poll are not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "Text export (`e` in session, or `--once`) ... Writes the same view model as plain text".
merged.reason: Edge-case gap for implementation detail.

merged.finding: No cell in the 116- and 80-column line forms is named to carry the `order unknown` and `conflict (time went back)` flags.
merged.evidence: UX :296 "A row missing both timestamps is flagged `order unknown`; a backward timestamp shows `conflict (time went back)`".
merged.reason: Placement gap; the flags are defined and appear in the inspector and export.

merged.finding: The initial cursor position and Enter with no selectable row are not defined.
merged.evidence: UX "`Enter` | open the inspector for the selected row".
merged.reason: Edge-case gap.

merged.finding: A mark spanning midnight and ages longer than the 7-cell age column are not handled.
merged.evidence: UX "on a monotonic clock" / "`changed since HH:MM (k)`".
merged.reason: Edge-case display gap.

merged.finding: Reviewer says citing T33 for the gap-notice rule is wrong because T33 tests only the fixture empty string.
merged.evidence: UX :418 "Gap notice rule (T33)".
merged.reason: The spec's own 'Empty states (T33)' rule at rendering-rules.md:61 carries the gap-notice wording, so the UX citation follows its source.

merged.finding: Reviewer says rows with absent or unknown `terminalState` may be hidden as historical.
merged.evidence: UX :240 "Historical rows (`terminalState` released or retained) are hidden by default".
merged.reason: False when checked: :240 hides only the two named values released and retained; absent or other values are outside that set and stay shown.

merged.finding: Reviewer says the start-up view choice can never pick Attention Ledger, or blocks, because it is made before any question poll.
merged.evidence: UX "If the question source has not succeeded in this process, the observer starts on the R1 ledger".
merged.reason: The UX copies the spec's start-up rule INV-021 (rendering-rules.md:7) faithfully and states the failure fallback at EXPERIENCE.md:478-486; changing it would make the UX contradict its source.
